courses.title: Breath Medicine
courses.description: A pack of five breathwork classes on Commune, eleven videos in all, ranging from slow resonance breathing to energising techniques. Schuyler blends classical pranayama with nervous-system science to help students calm down, focus or lift their energy when they need to.

courses.title: The Chill Pill
courses.description: A ten-day course on Commune of 20-minute sessions that slow and deepen the breath. Each class moves from seated breathing and light movement into longer-held yin postures and ends with reclined pranayama, set to a soundtrack by DJ Taz Rashid.

left_out: Back to the Core: the only Commune pages are sign-up pages, and https://www.onecommune.com/schuyler-core describes a past free period (20-24 January) with no current sales page; her own site (schuylergrant.com) blocks ClaudeBot in robots.txt, so it was not read. The back-pain framing itself would now be allowed.

Empowered Birth (https://www.onecommune.com/empowered-birth-free-trial): a 21-day pregnancy, labour and postpartum guide taught mostly by doctors, midwives and doulas, with Schuyler as host and teacher of a few short sessions; left out as medical guidance that is not mainly her teaching (scope, not the health rule).
flags: The original plan kept only 2 Commune courses ('only 2 Commune courses are allowed'); I found no such limit in the current brief or README, so Breath Medicine and The Chill Pill are added, making 4 Commune items. If a per-platform limit still applies, drop these.

Both pages use wellbeing wording the new rule allows: Breath Medicine is offered 'for anyone struggling with anxiety, insomnia, distraction, fatigue, or stress' and calls breathing a 'mobile pharmacy'; The Chill Pill promises relief from stress and anxiety, better sleep and 'improved digestion, faster physical recovery'. No disease is named.
